about: Authored evaluation set for ScoutForge term extraction. These job descriptions were written for this benchmark to resemble typical Berlin-Brandenburg manufacturing roles; they are not copies of real job postings. Gold labels were written before running either engine: 'relevant' lists every term a sourcer would reasonably put in a search for the role; 'must' lists the requirements a search must cover. Matching is case-insensitive and accepts a term if it contains a gold phrase as a whole word.

roles.jd:
Industrial Automation Engineer

We are hiring an automation engineer for a high-volume manufacturing plant.
Experience with PLCs, Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is important. You will troubleshoot industrial automation systems, maintain electrical equipment and improve production reliability.
Knowledge of Python, SQL, preventive maintenance and quality control would be useful. This role involves communication with maintenance and production teams.

Maintenance Technician – Body Shop (m/w/d)
What you'll do:
- Troubleshoot and repair KUKA and FANUC robots during 3-shift operation
- Maintain Siemens S7 PLCs using TIA Portal
- Read electrical schematics and carry out preventive maintenance
What you'll bring:
- Completed vocational training as Mechatroniker or Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik
- Experience with hydraulics and pneumatics
- German and English
Nice to have:
- Experience with SAP PM

Supplier Quality Engineer
You will lead supplier audits, drive 8D problem solving and approve PPAP submissions for battery and drive-unit components.
Requirements:
- Degree in mechanical engineering or similar
- Strong knowledge of IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 and FMEA
- Statistical process control and measurement system analysis
- Fluent English, German is a plus
Preferred: Six Sigma Green Belt, experience in automotive or battery manufacturing.

Logistics Associate – Intralogistics
You will supply production lines with material, operate forklifts and keep warehouse stock accurate in SAP EWM.
Your profile:
- Valid forklift licence (Staplerschein)
- Experience in warehouse or intralogistics operations
- Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
- Basic German skills
Experience with lean principles is an advantage.

Data Analyst – Production Analytics
Build dashboards that track OEE, scrap and downtime across the paint shop and general assembly.
What you bring:
- Advanced SQL and Python (pandas)
- Power BI or Tableau
- Experience with MES data and manufacturing KPIs
- Clear communication with engineers and managers
Nice to have: Databricks, machine learning basics.

AI Automation Intern – Sourcing
You will build AI-assisted sourcing workflows such as Boolean string generation, talent mapping and outreach drafting, and automate recruiting tasks with Python, Excel and low-code tools like Power Automate.
Requirements:
- Hands-on experience with generative AI tools and prompt design
- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, data analysis)
- Interest in active sourcing with LinkedIn Recruiter
VBA, SQL or Zapier experience is a plus. German is preferred.

Process Engineer – Battery Cell Manufacturing
Own the coating and calendering processes in our cell factory. Drive yield improvement with DOE and SPC, write work instructions and support ramp-up.
Requirements: degree in chemical, mechanical or process engineering; 3+ years in battery cell or similar high-volume production; experience with root cause analysis and FMEA. Python for data analysis is a plus.

SPS-Programmierer (m/w/d)
Ihre Aufgaben:
- Programmierung und Inbetriebnahme von Siemens S7-1500 Steuerungen im TIA Portal
- Fehlersuche an PROFINET-Netzwerken und WinCC-Visualisierungen
- Optimierung bestehender Anlagen
Ihr Profil:
- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Techniker
- Erfahrung mit Roboterprogrammierung (KUKA) von Vorteil
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse

EHS Specialist
Support occupational safety and environmental compliance for the stamping and casting shops. Conduct risk assessments, incident investigations and safety trainings, and maintain our ISO 14001 and EMAS certification.
Requirements: qualification as Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit or equivalent, knowledge of German health and safety law, excellent communication. Experience in automotive manufacturing is a plus.

Software Engineer – Manufacturing Systems
Develop services that connect production equipment to our manufacturing execution system. You will write backend services in C# and Python, design SQL schemas and integrate machines via OPC UA.
Requirements: 3+ years of software engineering, strong C# / .NET, SQL, Git and CI pipelines. Docker and Kubernetes are a plus, as is experience with PLC data.

Shift Leader General Assembly
Lead a team of 25 production associates on a rotating shift. Ensure safety, quality and output targets, run daily shift meetings and drive continuous improvement (Kaizen).
Requirements: experience leading production teams in automotive or similar industries, knowledge of lean manufacturing and 5S, SAP basics. Meister or Techniker qualification preferred. German and English required.
